name: Lift.KummerChart.PairingSide.mem_liftIdeal_of_derivation
summary: Lift (f − rt)·constantAt by x (exists_lift_of_mem_liftIdeal); then α·(zτE)⁻¹(gx − x) − βx lifts (s − r(αv − βt))·constantAt, where gt − t = zτEv: the Galois difference gains one step at E and keeps the other exponents.

steps.claim: By exists_lift_of_mem_liftIdeal at level 1: t in the chart ring such that (f − rt)·y lifts to locLetterPart(extLattice(S), 1, i) for every y ∈ locLetterPart(trivLattice(S), 1, i) (K).
g·t − t = zτ·E·v for some v (zTau_mul_E_dvd_smul_sub).
By mem_liftIdeal_iff with t' = αv − βt it suffices to lift (s − rt')·constantAt(S, i)(c) for every c ∈ C:
steps.lean:
mem_liftIdeal_iff.2 ⟨α * v - β * t,
  fun c ↦ (K _ (constantAt_mem_locLetterPart c)).rec fun x ⟨⟨m, o⟩, q⟩ ↦ ⟨_,
  sub_mem (smul_mem _ α (frobEUnit_zpow_mem_withExponents 0 (-1) (smul_sub_mem_zTauUnit_smul_of_deep
  (c := frobExponent 1 1 (stdExponent 0)) m (mem_withExponents_of_mem_hodgeFil
  (smul_sub_mem_withExponents o g) (·.rec (fun u v _ _ e ↦ by simpa [valueAt_smul_sub m.1 e.1] using
  (smul_sub_mem_hodgeFil_of_valueField g ![1] (valueAt_mem_valueField e.1 m) (o.2 0 u v _ e)
  (by simp [dvd_of_mul_left_dvd (zTau_mul_E_dvd_smul_sub ..)])))
  (by simp)))))) (smul_mem _ β o), smul_left_cancel (k.zTauUnit * k.frobEUnit 0) (by
  linear_combination (norm := (simp [k.galMonoid.smul_def, q, frobGroup_smul_smul, mul_smul,
    zTauUnit_smul, smul_comm _ α, smul_sub, constantAt, gal_smul_letterProj]; module)) congr(-($e +
    r * α * $hv) • S.constantAt i c))⟩⟩

steps.claim: constantAt(S, i)(c) ∈ locLetterPart(trivLattice(S), 1, i) (constantAt_mem_locLetterPart), so K gives x ∈ kisinLoc (m) with the standard exponents of level 1 (o) and projTriv(S)(x) = (f − rt)·constantAt(S, i)(c) (q); the lift is α·(zτ)⁻¹E⁻¹(g·x − x) − β·x:
steps.lean: fun c ↦ (K _ (constantAt_mem_locLetterPart c)).rec fun x ⟨⟨m, o⟩, q⟩ ↦ ⟨_,

steps.claim: it has the standard exponents of level 1: g·x − x has the exponents of x (smul_sub_mem_withExponents) and gains one step at a = 0 (its value there is a Galois difference of an element of 𝒦_0, smul_sub_mem_hodgeFil_of_valueField, with zτE | gs − s), i.e. it has frobExponent(1, 1, stdExponent(0)); dividing by zτ keeps them (smul_sub_mem_zTauUnit_smul_of_deep) and dividing by E = φ^0E lowers the exponent at a = 0 by one (frobEUnit_zpow_mem_withExponents 0 (−1)), giving stdExponent(1); and βx has them.
steps.lean:
sub_mem (smul_mem _ α (frobEUnit_zpow_mem_withExponents 0 (-1) (smul_sub_mem_zTauUnit_smul_of_deep
  (c := frobExponent 1 1 (stdExponent 0)) m (mem_withExponents_of_mem_hodgeFil
  (smul_sub_mem_withExponents o g) (·.rec (fun u v _ _ e ↦ by simpa [valueAt_smul_sub m.1 e.1] using
  (smul_sub_mem_hodgeFil_of_valueField g ![1] (valueAt_mem_valueField e.1 m) (o.2 0 u v _ e)
  (by simp [dvd_of_mul_left_dvd (zTau_mul_E_dvd_smul_sub ..)])))
  (by simp)))))) (smul_mem _ β o),

steps.claim: and its image is (s − rt')·constantAt(S, i)(c): after multiplying by the unit zτ·E, projTriv(S) of it is α(g − 1)((f − rt)·constantAt) − βzτE(f − rt)·constantAt; g fixes constantAt(c) (gal_smul_letterProj), gt = t + zτEv (step 2) and e give zτE(s − r(αv − βt))·constantAt(S, i)(c).
steps.lean:
smul_left_cancel (k.zTauUnit * k.frobEUnit 0) (by
  linear_combination (norm := (simp [k.galMonoid.smul_def, q, frobGroup_smul_smul, mul_smul,
    zTauUnit_smul, smul_comm _ α, smul_sub, constantAt, gal_smul_letterProj]; module)) congr(-($e +
    r * α * $hv) • S.constantAt i c))⟩⟩
